description: This Java source file defines the Tenant class, which models the schema and configuration details of a Hono Tenant in a device registry management system. It includes properties such as enabled status, extensions, defaults, adapters, resource limits, tracing configuration, and trusted certificate authorities. The class provides methods for validation, property manipulation, and querying tenant trust relationships.

classes.name: Tenant
classes.description: Represents a Hono Tenant schema object with configuration, properties, and validation methods.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant object has all required valid trusted certificate authorities.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether devices of this tenant can connect to Hono.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the tenant is enabled for device connections.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Replaces existing extension properties with new ones.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces a single extension property.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of the tenant's extension properties.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Replaces existing default device properties.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves the default device properties.

methods.name: setAdapters
methods.description: Sets protocol adapter configurations, ensuring each has a unique type.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of adapter configurations.

methods.name: addAdapterConfig
methods.description: Adds a new adapter configuration, ensuring type uniqueness.

methods.name: getMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum message size in bytes.

methods.name: setMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum message size, rejecting negative values.

methods.name: getResourceLimits
methods.description: Retrieves resource limits assigned to this tenant.

methods.name: setResourceLimits
methods.description: Sets resource limits for the tenant.

methods.name: getTracing
methods.description: Gets tenant's tracing configuration.

methods.name: setTracing
methods.description: Sets tenant's tracing configuration.

methods.name: getTrustedCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Retrieves list of trusted certificate authorities for this tenant.

methods.name: setTrustedCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Sets trusted certificate authorities, replacing existing list.

methods.name: getTrustedCertificateAuthoritySubjectDNs
methods.description: Returns the set of subject DNs from trusted CAs.

methods.name: hasTrustedCertificateAuthoritySubjectDN
methods.description: Checks if a given subject DN is trusted by this tenant.
